cs_current: I0*exp(-(t-1.0)/tau_s) from 1.0 ms, natural decay, no cutoff, continuous across associations
stdp_pairs: all actual pre/post spike pairs, continuous 50 ms history (500 ticks)
weight_update: W = clip(W + sum of pair dW over the association interval, -1, 1), applied once at the end of each association interval
gap_dynamics: identical to trial ticks: Euler update, threshold crossing, natural spike, reset, refractory (tested at interval start); gap spikes are post events for STDP
recall: teacher-free sequential readout on a copy of the continuous state after each epoch; bit=1 if any spike at 0.1..10.0 ms (k=1..100); gap spikes counted separately
presentation_order: a different permutation in every epoch: datasets/*_K10.npz presentation_orders (1000x10), generated once with numpy.random.default_rng(0).permutation(10) per epoch, identical for Original and Modified and identical to baseline_v1; rows are reused cyclically after epoch 1000
